mismatches: The screw holes are not centered at y=0; they appear to be offset towards the back/side (center of cylindrical faces shows y=1.75 instead of 0).
The screw hole axes are along Z, not along X as required by R3.
The part fails requirement R7: the measured mass is 119.34g, which exceeds the limit of 90g.
The design document specifies a tapered profile to reduce mass, but the render shows a constant thickness arm (no taper visible).
The screw holes are at z=35 and z=75 according to measured facts, whereas R3 requires them at z=20 and z=60.
systemic: The screwdriver access requirement (R3) cannot be met because the screw holes are oriented along Z instead of X, making it impossible to drive a screw through the wall into the bracket.
summary: The part fails multiple requirements including mass limits, hole orientation, hole placement, and the intended tapered geometry.
